thread:
nina: heads-up — seeing a spike of fncall validation routes into fallback in eu-west-1. variant token usage up but console shows nothing labelled 'validation' :confused:

gabe: can you paste a sample log? need to know reason (missing_field / extra_props / type_mismatch / parse_error)

nina: log snippet: ```WARN validate_fncall req=kk-42 reason=missing_field field=tool.args.account_id route=primary->fallback_variant```

rui: that pattern means model emitted a payload missing required args. current behavior: route to fallback and keep counting tokens against fallback variant. product sees cost but not cause.

alert-bot: schema-validator: reason=missing_field count=74 route=fallback_variant sampling=0.05

gabe: telemetry proposal: add metric fncall_validation_total{route,reason,outcome,slice} with outcome in (accepted,soft_reject,routed,hard_reject). Also add trace tags validation.reason and fallback_variant. Example prom: `sum(rate(fncall_validation_total{outcome="routed"}[5m])) by (route,reason)`

nina: +1 but cardinality cap: reason enum must be tiny. slice should be limited to predefined canaries.

billing: billing: please tag events with validation_status=routed in the kafka stream so billing can decide offline. don't change charges yet.

rui: UX ask: add a compact probe on variant page titled "Validation routing" with sparkline + top reasons. click reason -> open redacted samples. Link to RFC.

ui-team: we can do a probe card. question: can metrics include an exemplar label so probe links directly to a sample trace?

gabe: yes add exemplar="trace:<id>" label on the metric as a pointer. keep exemplars sparse. prom example: `fncall_validation_total{route="fallback",reason="missing_field",exemplar="trace:abcd1234"}`

nina: samples API must redact any key matching /(email|token|ssn|api_key|phone)/i and truncate long text > 400 chars. default sample_rate=0.05 for noise reasons, 1.0 for parse_error.

rui: open question: should routed requests count toward customer quotas and rate limits? I vote yes for accounting predictability but mark them separately so product can decide billing later.

billing: agree count+tag. quotas depend on predictable enforcement; retro adjustments are painful.

gabe: alert rule draft: page if (sum(rate(fncall_validation_total{outcome="routed"}[5m])) by(route) / sum(rate(fncall_requests_total[5m])) by(route)) > 0.01 AND token_spike > 1.10. message should include top_reason and exemplar id.

nina: rollout plan: implement metric+trace tags in staging -> wire up samples endpoint -> add probe to staging console -> run 30m canary per-slice (owner-run) -> collect traces and decide billing. I'll reserve the canary window tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

gabe: I'll draft a short RFC with metric names, enums, exemplar usage, sample API, and canary checklist. stub: https://console.redwood.ai/rfcs/validator-routing-quota-probe (WIP)

ui-team: will prototype the probe tile copy to avoid alarming language (e.g., "Some requests were routed to a fallback variant due to validation").

nina: thanks — please post RFC link here when ready. if alerts keep spiking I'll mute the slice and revert strict-validate for that canary. :thumbsup:
